classes.purpose: Static item-definition (base item config) record loaded into a CInfoManager<CItemBaseInfo> singleton and looked up by item id. Holds an item's id, internal/config name, display name, type/subtype category, per-type stack/carry limit and various boolean gameplay flags. Almost none of the 41 grouped functions are true members of the class: the auto-grouper collected every function that references the manager-singleton name string "CItemBaseInfo::GetManagers". Most are consumers in OTHER classes (bag/inventory validators, resource precachers, crafting/equip/NPC-sale logic) that resolve the item table via the singleton and do a 2D-sparse-array GetById.

methods.purpose: The real accessor. Lazily registers the name "CItemBaseInfo" with StcMbrNameSvr<CInfoManager> (guarded by DAT_123bdbfc one-shot flag) and returns the CInfoManager<CItemBaseInfo>* stored at DAT_123bdba0. All other functions inline a copy of this to reach the item table.

Parses a chat/GM command struct (char* fields at +0x18/+0x28/+0x38/+0x48), matches the leading token against "gm" (compare vs 0x6d67), _strtoui64-parses numeric args, and drives the HornNumDialogOK/HornNumDialogCancel numeric-input dialog. Resolves an item via the manager. Low confidence on exact command semantics.

Calls CAvatarInfo::GetManagers, reads a character/avatar info struct (fields +0xb8..+0xe4, name strings +0x50/+0x68/+0x80) and pushes strings/arrays to a network/render sink via vtable+0x32c; copies equipment id vectors (+0x19c..+0x1ac). Aborts with puts("out of memory")/exit on alloc failure. Client appearance/equip snapshot builder; only incidentally touches the item table.

Iterates a collection (vtable+0x18 count, vtable+0x1c getAt), resolves each id in the item manager, strcpy_s copies the item display name (+0xb4) into a 32-byte buffer, and emits it via a UI/message sink (FUN_111e0a50 vtable+4, tag 0x32).

If param_1[5]==*param_2, walks an entry array (this[0xd]..this[0xe], stride 0x20), string-compares (FUN_100fd0c0) each entry name against param_2+2 and, when equal and entry[0x18]==param_2[1], sets entry[0x1c]=1 (a 'matched/selected' flag). Low confidence on owning class.

Looks up a CManufactureInfo record by id, reads result item (+0x58), fields +0x60/+0x64/+0x78/+0x7c and a materials vector (+0x84..+0x88, stride 0x20). Resolves item display names (+0xb4) and emits recipe header (tag 0x74) and per-material rows (tag 0x77) to a message sink. Medium confidence.

Reads a manager/table via param_1[3], builds two copied lists (0x38-byte records) with memcpy, resolves item names (+0xb4) into 0x40 buffers, and sends each record (tag 0x106). Uses a red-black-tree membership test on ids. out-of-memory guarded. Low confidence.

Copies param_2[0..5] into this[0x7bf..0x7c4]; if the item id (this[0x7c1]) resolves and item.type(+0x34)==4 and item[+0x11c]==2, stores item[+0x16c] into this[0x7bb]; then invokes vtable+0x1a4 with &this[0x7bf]. Applies an equipped item's derived bonus/id to an actor.

Given add/remove lists (two vectors, stride 0x18 and 0xc), accumulates per-item running counts in an RB-tree keyed by hash, then checks each item's stack/carry limit via FUN_113f9ee0 (item+0x48) against existing count. Returns TDR-style error codes 0x34 (bad id range), 0x40, 0x32, 0x29 (capacity), 0 on success.
Simplified sibling of 113fc2e0: builds count map keyed by FUN_11669730 hash over add/remove vectors, validates against item stack limit (+0x48). Returns 0x32, 0x28, 0.

Full inventory add/remove validation over two operation vectors (this+0x8/0xc and +0x14/0x18). Derives an item category (0/1/2/5/9 from item.type +0x34, flags +0x68/+0xc4), computes needed slots via FUN_113f7100, and enforces per-item stack limit (+0x48) and per-category grid capacity. On failure writes error code to param_2+0x50 (0x28 stack, 0x29 grid, 0x2a category, 0x35 empty) and offending id to param_2+0x58; returns bool.
Resolves a CNpcSaleInfo record by id, walks an item's price/component vector (item+0x9c..+0xa0, stride 0x20), and computes a sale price with ceil()/double math (FUN_114b66e0). Medium-low confidence.

Loot/drop roller. Consumes a list node stream (param_3+0x20 intrusive list), uses rand (FUN_100ee450) scaled by _DAT_11de98f0 over a min/max range to pick a count, resolves the item, validates via FUN_113f7d00/FUN_11521920, and appends granted (itemId,count,quality) triples into param_4; writes counts to out params. Low-medium confidence.

Processes an equip transform step list; switch on step type: 1=copy equip stats from a source (FUN_1166c4b0, fields +0xa8/+0xe0/+0xe4/+0xe8/+0xb0/+0xac), 2=CEquipLevelUpConsumeInfo lookup, 3=CItemBaseInfo+CEquipInfo lookup to rebuild an equip instance (clamps level/exp against caps, copies attribute list). Medium-low confidence.

Enumerates the whole item table (via FUN_102551f0("CItemBaseInfo") + [5]/[6] linear array) and substring-matches each item's name (input string param_1+0x14) with FUN_100fd370; collects matching item ids (record+0x10) into output array param_3, count in *param_2, capped at 200. A genuine table query helper.
If this[0x15]!=0 resolves a CBuffInfo, then iterates this[0x18..] (3 slots, stride 8) touching the item manager to force-load referenced items. Reference/precache walker.
Walks an RB-tree (this+0xd8/0xe0) and, for each node, an inner vector (this+0xc0/0xc4, stride 8), touching the item manager per element. Item reference/precache pass. Low confidence on owner.
Same precache pattern as 117b5360 but over tree this+0xec/0xf4 and inner vector this+0xd4/0xd8. Low confidence.
Iterates a container (this+0x28/0x2c, stride 8) touching the item manager per element. Item reference/precache pass. Low confidence.

Iterates this[0x24..0x25] entries; for entries whose vtable+4 type==0xe touches the item manager; then resolves a CCommodityGroupInfo by id this[0x16] and caches the record pointer into this[0x2a] (or 0 if not found). Low-medium confidence.
Precaches items (vector this+0x18/0x1c, stride 8) and buffs (CBuffInfo manager, vector this+0x24/0x28, stride 8); trailing loops are degenerate/no-op sort scaffolding. Reference/precache pass.
Nested precache: outer vector this+0x18/0x1c (stride 0x18), inner vector at entry+0xc/+0x10 (stride 4), touching the item manager per id. Low confidence.

Walks nested vectors (this+0x14/0x18 stride 0x10, inner stride 4); for each id resolves the item and bails unless item flag +0xc4!=0 and item.type(+0x34)==2. Validates that all referenced items are of category 2. Low-medium confidence.

Debug/export dump: writes tab-separated "id\tname" text files for several data tables — tbItemDataConf.txt (CItemBaseInfo, name field record+0x14), tbInstanceNameConf.txt (CMHLevelInfo +0x1c), tbGiftBagNameConf.txt (CGiftBagGroupInfo), tbGiftNameConf.txt (CTalentInfo +0x78), tbMartConf.txt (CMartGoodsInfo +0x18). Confirms vtable+0x18=GetId and the manager linear-array layout. Medium-high confidence.
Iterates a vector (this+0x14/0x18, stride 0x14) touching the item manager per element. Reference/precache pass. Low confidence.
Touches the CItemBaseInfo singleton then registers/returns the CCommodityGroupInfo CInfoManager singleton (DAT_123c747c). Effectively a CCommodityGroupInfo manager accessor.
Iterates this+0x60..this+0x64 (stride 4) touching the item manager. Reference/precache pass.
If this[0x18]==3, touches the item manager once (ensures a referenced item is loaded for a type-3 object).
Walks an RB-tree (this+0x14 root, iterate from +0x1c) touching the item manager per node. Reference/precache pass.
Walks two containers (this+0x1c/0x20 and this+0x2c/0x30, stride 8) touching the item manager per element. Reference/precache pass.
Near-duplicate of 11a0c290 (same two-container item precache, different init-guard label). Reference/precache pass.
Iterates this+0x14 as 5 slot pairs (stride 8); for each non-null slot touches the item manager. Reference/precache pass.
Resolves CPetSkillInfo (this[0x12]) then iterates this+0xc as 3 slot pairs touching the item manager. Pet-skill + item reference/precache pass.
Resolves a fixed CNpcSaleInfo entry (index 0x2c), if present calls FUN_117da950 with this->GetId(vtable+0x18); then returns the CItemBaseInfo manager singleton. Low-medium confidence.

Resolves CFinalGuildMatchRewardInfo and a CGuildMatchInfo by id (this[0x10]); if valid, iterates a reward vector (this+0x20/0x24, stride 0x10) touching the item manager per reward. Guild-match reward item precache.
Iterates a vector (this+0x1c/0x20, stride 0x10) touching the item manager per element. Reference/precache pass.
Walks an RB-tree (this+0x14 root, from +0x1c) touching the item manager per node. Reference/precache pass (sibling of 11a07860).
If this.type(+0x34) is 2 or in [4,6) and this[0x38]>0, returns the resolved CItemBaseInfo manager (used as a guarded accessor for equip-like items). Otherwise returns the raw type value.
Calls CAchieveLibInfo::GetManagers, touches the item manager if this[0x28]>0, then registers/returns the CHunterStarStatInfo CInfoManager singleton (DAT_122de664).
Plain inlined copy of the manager-singleton accessor (returns CInfoManager<CItemBaseInfo>* at DAT_123bdba0). Functionally identical to 10254050.
Another plain inlined copy of the manager-singleton accessor (returns DAT_123bdba0). Identical to 10254050/11a87b20.

formulas: CInfoManager::GetById(id): let base=mgr+0x30, count=mgr+0x24, divisor=mgr+0x28, array=mgr+0x20. Valid iff id!=-1, !(id==0 && base!=0), divisor!=0, and 0 <= (id-base) < count. Then entry = array[(id-base)/divisor][(id-base)%divisor] (2D sparse bucket table). Same struct viewed via FUN_11679e10 result uses word indices [0xc]=base,[9]=count,[10]=divisor,[8]=array; linear enumeration uses [5]/[6] begin/end pointers, count=([6]-[5])>>2.

Bag validation error codes (written to op-struct+0x50): 0x28=per-item stack limit exceeded (offending id at +0x58), 0x29=grid/slot capacity exceeded, 0x2a=category capacity, 0x32/0x34/0x40=id out of table range, 0x35=empty/invalid op.
Needed-slots for a stack add ~ ceil((requiredCount - existingCount) / perStackMax) i.e. (required - existing - 1 + perStack)/perStack (114014c0).
NPC sale price computed with double math + ceil() over an item price/component vector (114b5ed0).
Drop roll count = base + floor(rand01 * (max-min+1)) then item/limit validated (114bcea0).
relatedTlv: TlvItem (0x99) — RUNTIME item instance (itemId int64, itemType, posColumn, posGrid, count, bind, attrCount, ext-attr arrays), NOT this static config record; field layouts differ. CItemBaseInfo is the server-side static item definition table, so treat the mapping as thematic only.
classes.notes: The 41 grouped functions share only the singleton-name string "CItemBaseInfo::GetManagers"; only ~4 are genuine CItemBaseInfo members (the manager accessor 10254050 and its inlined duplicates 11a87b20/11a880c0, plus the table query FindItemsByName 1159dc20). The rest live in other classes (bag validators, resource precachers, crafting/equip/NPC/guild logic) and merely resolve items through the singleton. vtable offsets confirmed: +0x18=GetId, +0x28=GetCount. All record field offsets are inferred from consumer usage (Ghidra had no param types); none came from a dedicated DebugFormat/TLV reader in this bundle, so offset confidence is medium. The dump function 1187f880 is the strongest evidence for name fields and manager layout.
